title: Share one physical guide across current native reset banks
body:
This construction replaces the per-bank guide array with **one shared physical ruler** for the pinned 234-parent/234-child native tuple. Its seven-tape program produces the guide, executes all 468 source reset services, returns every service head, clears its address counters and retires the guide. At N=512,W=1, complete retained capacity falls from **2398032 to 1202130 cells**. Selection takes more travel; every added traversal is charged. **No new kappa or complete recursive storage bound is claimed.**

Read the [all-size proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/PROOF.md), [checked receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/RESULT.json), [complete emitted table](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/TABLES.json.gz), [emitter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/assembly.py), [two-interpreter verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/verify.py), [retained input pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/SOURCES.json) and [copied source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/VENDORED.json).

This answers the guide-sharing question in [PR #7667](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7667), exact source `776e58c3879193d68d0da586d0ff5c07bdb96010`. The storage comparison is [PR #7666](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7666), exact source `93710078d292f6702aaa12d47a1c97a5e3051674`. The native plan remains pinned to [PR #7663](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7663), scientific commit `b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013`. The newer [PR #7669](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7669) has a different word and caller; this result does not transfer its inventory or certify that candidate.

The caller supplies canonical positive binary N,W, blank conversion work, exact owned windows and disjoint same-format bank slots. For `L=N(2W+3)`, each physical ruler pass crosses one complete `L+2` cell slot. A literal unary counter selects the fixed bank number. The unchanged source reset graph writes only the selected payload. Reverse passes return the data head; every counter marker is erased. All parked banks, guards, input descriptors and borrowed exterior cells are preserved. The service blocks contain no guide-write instruction.

The 94675-row table is fixed before N,W are supplied. It has seven tapes, unit moves and no runtime host address operations. The exact service cost for slot k is `(14k+9)L+c(k)+39k+12bitlength(k)+47`, using the retained exact binary-converter cost c. The complete 468-service sum is **2300688L + 10458512**. The proof adds guide production and retirement, retains the maximum work span across phases, and charges every reserved data bank. The full-view storage difference is 1196454 removed guide cells minus 552 added control cells: **1195902 fewer cells**. This is a local cell comparison, not a global bit tariff. Finite control loading has a separate positive constant charge.

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/current-shared-guide-banks
```

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_CURRENT_SHARED_GUIDE_BANKS
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
```

Normal and optimized replay passed. An independent reverse scan checks every source lifetime. Both sparse and independent dense interpreters execute all 468 services at N=W=1, the last child at N=512,W=1, and six additional shapes. Complete cells, heads and instruction counts agree. The full schedule takes 21962186 instructions and retains 3780 cells at L=5. Six actual instruction mutations detect wrong stride, reversed travel, a guide write, missing returns and incomplete counter retirement. Committed bytes, source ancestry, the 31-file official export and read-only Git-free optimized replay passed. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44244862508/job/134601249225) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Limits: the 234-child inventory belongs to one RAW native word. The complete compiled recursive inventory, root descriptors, arbitrary old work outside the admitted windows, numerical children, native adapters, cross-depth ownership, common whole-algorithm pricing and outer recovery remain open. A numerical child must preserve the shared guide and parked banks and return the agreed work/head boundary. Its cost is unknown here, not zero. The full 468-service schedule at N=512 and the complete multiplier were not executed. All five inherited assumptions and the selected kappa remain unchanged.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. David Arias supplied the unchanged machine, assembler and binary counter, as stated in the [retained notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing/NOTICE) and [counter proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing/core/inputs/COUNTER-PROOF.md). @thu-nmrc supplied the package that retains them in [PR #6719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6719). @aliromman supplied the unchanged guide lifecycle and source native bank plan. @CubeJerry supplied the predecessor primitive and typed reset in [PR #7586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7586). The [copied notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/677d23ef1610db9921547ab5d58eecc8c8d4c08b/research/current-shared-guide-banks/source/NOTICE) retains the full native lineage. Ali Romman directed this new construction, proof and verification with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0; all copied source bytes are unchanged.
